subject: Classwork board and a small favor
text: Anyway, the classwork assignment made me think I was missing something, and when I looked at the shared board again I saw the deadline had moved without a clear note. I wrote to my neighbor about it, since they are also enrolled, but the question is messier than I sound. Could you ask whether the short summary should go in the same folder or be emailed? If it is easier, just mention it when you see the coordinator. I know this is a small favor, and I do not want to bother anyone who already has enough on their list. I keep mixing up the module code and the room code, so if your reply mentions only a number I may need one more sentence. The readings are due earlier than I expected, which is throwing off my evening plans a little. No need today, but a quick confirmation would stop me emailing again after work. Sorry if this is scattered, I am trying to sort it.
